load_data: create a MultiDataset from training data paths using load_data with an opt config and tokenizer
load_dataset: load PyTorch tensor files from a data directory using load_dataset with split, full, or single mode
MultiDataset: build a weighted sampling dataset wrapper using MultiDataset that combines multiple Dataset instances with configurable probabilities
Collator: create a batch collator using Collator that builds masked token tensors from a list of batch examples
load_passages: load passage documents from a JSONL or TSV file using load_passages for retrieval tasks
